blocks.text: Maddah chaar halaton (states) mein maujood hai: thos (solid), maya (liquid), gas aur plasma. Maddah ki sab se sada shakal gas ki halat hai, aur hamare gird zyada tar maddah thos hai. Liquids solids, gases aur plasmas se kam aam hain, kyunke kisi bhi madde ki liquid halat sirf darja hararat aur dabao ki nisbatan tang had mein maujood reh sakti hai. Gases ka kinetic molecular theory gases, liquids aur solids ki khusoosiyat samajhne mein madad karta hai.

items: Gases ki koi muqarrar shakal ya hajm nahi; gas ka hajm us ke bartan ka hajm hai.
Ideal gases ka particle volume sifar hai.

Gas ke molecules ek doosre se bohat door hain aur gas ka zyada tar hajm khali jagah hai (taqreeban 99.9 feesad), isi liye gases asani se dabti (compress hoti) hain. Jab gas achanak phailti hai to thandak paida hoti hai: Joule-Thomson effect.
Gas ka dabao us ke molecules ke bartan ki deewaron se takrane ki wajah se hai.
Ideal gases mein intermolecular forces na-hone ke barabar hain.

blocks.alt: Zarraat ke teen dabbe: gas ke dabbe mein chand neele nuqte azad urte hue, liquid ke dabbe ke neeche hisse mein qareeb qareeb neele nuqte, aur solid ke dabbe mein jamni nuqton ki jaali, har ek ke neeche us ki khusoosiyat. Neeche, bartanon ke do jore dikhate hain ke dabao dugna hone par hawa ka hajm aadha ho jata hai jabke pani mushkil se badalta hai.
blocks.caption: Gas, liquid aur solid mein zarraat, aur dabao dugna karne ka asar (Figure 5.1 aur chhapi hui khusoosiyat ki fehriston ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Gas mein molecules bohat door hain, to gas apna bartan bhar deti hai, taqreeban sari khali jagah hai aur asani se dabti hai; us ka dabao deewaron par molecules ki thap hai. Liquid mein molecules chhoote hain magar ek doosre ke paas se guzarte hain, to hajm muqarrar hai, liquid behta aur phailta (diffuse) hai, aur bohat kam dabta hai. Solid mein zarraat apni jagah jame hain aur sirf larazte hain. Dabao dugna karne se hawa ka hajm aadha ho jata hai magar pani sirf 0.0045 feesad sukarta hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke gases asani se kyun dabti hain, aur Joule-Thomson effect kya hai.
blocks.explanation: Gas ke hajm ka taqreeban 99.9 feesad door door molecules ke darmiyan khali jagah hai, to unhen qareeb dabana kam mehnat leta hai. Jab gas ko achanak phailne diya jaye to woh thandi ho jati hai; achanak phailne par yeh thandak Joule-Thomson effect hai.

items: Chaar halatein: solid, liquid, gas, plasma; gases sab se sada hain, liquids sirf darja hararat aur dabao ki tang had mein maujood hain.

Gases: koi muqarrar shakal ya hajm nahi, taqreeban 99.9 feesad khali jagah (asani se dabti hain), deewar se takrane se dabao, ideal hone par sifar particle volume aur na-hone ke barabar forces, achanak phailne par Joule-Thomson thandak.
